name: Hahnenkamm
kurzbeschreibung: The Hahnenkamm in Kitzbühel at 1,712 m above sea level: venue of the legendary Streif, Hahnenkammbahn, Starthaus, and panoramic hikes.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hahnenkamm is a 1,712-metre-high mountain summit in the Kitzbüheler Alpen and ranks among the most world-famous sports mountains in the Alps. Situated directly above the historic chamois town of Kitzbühel, the mountain attained global legendary status as the venue for the annual Hahnenkamm-Rennen. On the notorious downhill course Streif and the slalom slope Ganslern, the world's best ski racers compete every January in front of tens of thousands of enthusiastic spectators. In summer, the mountain transforms into a family-friendly hiking paradise featuring breathtaking views of the Wilder Kaiser and the Hohe Tauern.

Race History & Summer Experience

The racing tradition on the Hahnenkamm began in 1931, when the Kitzbüheler Ski Club hosted the first international Hahnenkamm-Rennen; the first champion on the Streif was the Austrian Ferdl Friedensbacher. With jumps of up to 80 metres at the Mausefalle, gradients of up to 85 percent (40.4 degrees) in the steepest section, and speeds reaching 140 km/h, the Streif is considered the most demanding and perilous World Cup downhill run in the world. Skiing legends like Toni Sailer, Karl Schranz, Franz Klammer, and Didier Cuche made sports history here. The first Hahnenkammbahn opened back in 1928; today, a modern 6-passenger monocable gondola carries visitors in around nine minutes to the mountain station at 1,662 metres. Every gondola is named after a winner of these legendary races. In summer, the Sommererlebnis Streif adventure trail starts directly at the mountain station: along the key course sections runs an interactive themed trail with nine stations, including the historic Starthaus, climbing courses, and info terminals with race analyses.

Visit & Getting There

The Hahnenkammbahn operated by Bergbahn AG KitzSki runs in summer from mid-May to early November daily from 08:30 to 17:00; in winter, ski operations start between November and April depending on snow conditions. Summer 2025/2026 fares (round-trip ascent and descent): adults €35.00 (with guest card €33.00), youth approx. €19.50, children (vintage 2011–2020) €12.50, toddlers free. Cable car travel is free with the Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card. Use of the hiking trails and the adventure Starthaus is free of charge. Travel by train: ÖBB to Kitzbühel Hahnenkamm station, the entrance to the cable car valley station is located directly opposite the platform. By car: via the B161 (Pass-Thurn-Straße) to Kitzbühel, large paid cable car car park at Hahnenkammstraße 1.

Tips

The valley and mountain stations of the Hahnenkammbahn as well as the panoramic restaurants along the mountain ridge are barrier-free; the panoramic terrace provides guests with reduced mobility with a fantastic panoramic vista. A walk to the Streif Starthaus and to the Ehrenbachhöhe reservoir is an absolute must for any visitor to Kitzbühel. Stop for refreshments at the historic Berggasthof Hahnenkamm or at the Hochkitzbühel restaurant.
oeffnungszeiten: Bergbahn Mitte Mai bis Anfang Nov täglich 08:30–17:00 Uhr (Winter 08:30–16:30 Uhr)
